# Caveats through the schema's operators: unions, intersections,
# exclusions, usersets, arrows and cycles. Answers combine as Kleene's
# three-valued logic, and a conditional answer names every parameter that
# could still change it.

schema
  caveat flag(on bool) { on }
  
  caveat gate(open bool) { open }
  
  caveat ip_allowed(allowed cidr, client_ip ipaddress) { allowed.containsIP(client_ip) }
  
  definition user {}
  
  definition group {
    relation member: user | user with flag | group#member | group#member with gate
  }
  
  definition folder {
    relation parent: folder | folder with gate
    relation viewer: user | user with flag | group#member
    permission view = viewer + parent->view
  }
  
  definition doc {
    relation parent: folder | folder with flag
    relation viewer: user | user with ip_allowed | user:* | user:* with gate | group#member | group#member with flag
    relation editor: user | user with flag
    relation banned: user | user with flag | user with gate
    permission view = (viewer + editor + parent->view) - banned
    permission edit = editor & viewer
  }

case union: allowed wins, conditionals add their parameters
write doc:d#viewer@user:a with ip_allowed
write doc:d#editor@user:a with flag
check doc:d#view@user:a => conditional[allowed client_ip on]
check doc:d#view@user:a {"on":true} => allowed
check doc:d#view@user:a {"on":false} => conditional[allowed client_ip]
check doc:d#view@user:a {"on":false,"allowed":"10.0.0.0/8","client_ip":"10.0.0.1"} => allowed
check doc:d#view@user:a {"on":false,"allowed":"10.0.0.0/8","client_ip":"8.8.8.8"} => denied

case intersection: denied wins
write doc:d#viewer@user:a with ip_allowed {"allowed":"10.0.0.0/8"}
write doc:d#editor@user:a with flag
write doc:d#editor@user:b with flag
check doc:d#edit@user:a => conditional[client_ip on]
check doc:d#edit@user:a {"on":false} => denied
check doc:d#edit@user:a {"client_ip":"8.8.8.8"} => denied
check doc:d#edit@user:a {"on":true} => conditional[client_ip]
check doc:d#edit@user:a {"on":true,"client_ip":"10.1.1.1"} => allowed
# b is no viewer, so the flag cannot matter.
check doc:d#edit@user:b => denied

case exclusion: a conditional ban is never allowed
write doc:d#viewer@user:a
write doc:d#banned@user:a with flag
check doc:d#view@user:a => conditional[on]
check doc:d#view@user:a {"on":true} => denied
check doc:d#view@user:a {"on":false} => allowed
resources doc#view@user:a => d?[on]
subjects doc:d#view@user => a?[on]

case exclusion: both sides conditional
write doc:d#viewer@user:a with ip_allowed
write doc:d#banned@user:a with gate
check doc:d#view@user:a => conditional[allowed client_ip open]
check doc:d#view@user:a {"open":true} => denied
check doc:d#view@user:a {"allowed":"10.0.0.0/8","client_ip":"8.8.8.8"} => denied
check doc:d#view@user:a {"allowed":"10.0.0.0/8","client_ip":"10.0.0.8"} => conditional[open]

case a ban decided by its stored context
write doc:d#viewer@user:a
write doc:d#viewer@user:b
write doc:d#banned@user:a with flag {"on":true}
write doc:d#banned@user:b with flag {"on":false}
check doc:d#view@user:a {"on":false} => denied
check doc:d#view@user:b {"on":true} => allowed
subjects doc:d#view@user => b

case wildcard minus a conditional ban
write doc:d#viewer@user:*
write doc:d#banned@user:x with flag
check doc:d#view@user:y => allowed
check doc:d#view@user:x => conditional[on]
subjects doc:d#view@user => *-x x?[on]
subjects doc:d#view@user {"on":true} => *-x
subjects doc:d#view@user {"on":false} => *

case caveated wildcard minus a plain ban
write doc:d#viewer@user:* with gate
write doc:d#banned@user:x
check doc:d#view@user:y => conditional[open]
check doc:d#view@user:x => denied
check doc:d#view@user:x {"open":true} => denied
subjects doc:d#view@user => *-x?[open]
subjects doc:d#view@user {"open":true} => *-x

case a caveated userset and caveated memberships multiply
write group:g#member@user:a with flag
write group:g#member@user:b
write doc:d#viewer@group:g#member with flag
check doc:d#view@user:a => conditional[on]
check doc:d#view@user:b => conditional[on]
check doc:d#view@user:b {"on":true} => allowed
check doc:d#view@user:a {"on":false} => denied
check doc:d#view@group:g#member => conditional[on]
subjects doc:d#view@user => a?[on] b?[on]
subjects doc:d#view@group#member => g?[on]

case nested groups with a gate between them
write group:inner#member@user:a with flag
write group:outer#member@group:inner#member with gate
write doc:d#viewer@group:outer#member
check doc:d#view@user:a => conditional[on open]
check doc:d#view@user:a {"open":true} => conditional[on]
check doc:d#view@user:a {"open":false} => denied
check doc:d#view@user:a {"open":true,"on":true} => allowed
check group:outer#member@user:a {"on":true} => conditional[open]

case a caveat on a cycle
write group:a#member@group:b#member with gate
write group:b#member@group:a#member
write group:b#member@user:u
write group:a#member@user:v with flag
check group:a#member@user:u => conditional[open]
check group:a#member@user:u {"open":true} => allowed
check group:b#member@user:u => allowed
check group:b#member@user:v {"on":true} => allowed
check group:b#member@user:v {"on":false} => denied
check group:a#member@user:w => denied
check group:a#member@user:v {"on":true} => allowed
# A check walks simple paths, so it names only "on" for v in a and in b.
# The subject lookup's fixpoint goes round the cycle once more and also
# names "open", which cannot change the answer (#257). Permissionship
# agrees.
subjects group:a#member@user => u?[open] v?[on open]
subjects group:b#member@user => u v?[on open]

case caveated arrows and parents
write doc:d#parent@folder:f with flag
write folder:f#parent@folder:root with gate
write folder:root#viewer@user:a
write folder:f#viewer@user:b with flag
check doc:d#view@user:a => conditional[on open]
check doc:d#view@user:a {"on":true,"open":true} => allowed
check doc:d#view@user:a {"on":true,"open":false} => denied
check doc:d#view@user:b => conditional[on]
check doc:d#view@user:b {"on":true} => allowed
check folder:f#view@user:a {"on":false} => conditional[open]
resources folder#view@user:a => root f?[open]
resources doc#view@user:a {"on":true} => d?[open]

case the same subject through a plain and a caveated path
write doc:d#viewer@user:a with ip_allowed
write group:g#member@user:a
write doc:d#viewer@group:g#member
check doc:d#view@user:a => allowed
check doc:d#view@user:a {"allowed":"10.0.0.0/8","client_ip":"8.8.8.8"} => allowed
